## Discovery & Translational Science

* **[Biotech]** **Verily, NVIDIA, and NIH build multimodal EHR-genomics foundation model** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/spons/the-next-frontier-advancing-foundation-models-with-multimodal-data/828675/)
  * Verily Health, in collaboration with NVIDIA and the NIH All of Us Research Program, developed an AI foundation model integrating electronic health records (EHR) with genomic data.
  * The multimodal model aims to combine baseline genetic risk with longitudinal clinical outcomes to identify complex disease risk patterns prior to symptom onset.

* **TRIM26 promotes ferroptosis to suppress nasopharyngeal carcinoma** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42669105/)
  * Mechanistic research demonstrated that TRIM26 triggers ferroptosis via ZEB1 degradation, inhibiting nasopharyngeal carcinoma disease progression.

* **M4 drug discovery framework predicts GLP-1R agonist translation** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42669385/)
  * Researchers validated the M4 predictive platform, which integrates preclinical data streams to project human clinical performance, using a glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor (GLP-1R) agonist model.

* **Ferritin-fused LL-37 peptide enhances efficacy in sepsis model** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42669340/)
  * Fusion of the antimicrobial peptide LL-37 to a ferritin carrier improved targeted delivery, yielding enhanced antibacterial and anti-inflammatory outcomes in a mouse model of sepsis.

* **DSC-bsite dynamic-static model improves target binding prediction** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42669106/)
  * A novel dynamic-static collaborative multimodal graph learning method (DSC-bsite) was developed to accurately identify small-molecule binding sites on target proteins.

* **Nine-trial synthesis models safety of multi-drug heart failure regimens** [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04623-z)
  * A cross-trial analysis of 38,753 patients across nine clinical trials quantified the short-term impact of combination medical therapy on blood pressure, renal function, and serum potassium levels to inform safer initiation strategies.

* **Multimodal transformer improves glucose forecasting from continuous monitors** [bioRxiv/medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.06.01.26354646)
  * Evaluated across 1,752 non-diabetic participants from the Framingham Heart Study, a residual-gated multimodal transformer outperformed standard LSTM and transformer architectures in forecasting postprandial glucose dynamics without requiring precise meal logs.

* **Oncology researchers re-evaluate radiopharmaceutical dosing boundaries** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/31/radiopharmaceuticals-dosing-pushing-bounds-cancer-treatment/?utm_campaign=rss)
  * Radiopharmaceutical clinical researchers are challenging conventional conservative dosing frameworks to maximize therapeutic efficacy in solid tumor treatments.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **Personalized mRNA melanoma vaccine success drives broader oncology platform expansion** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/31/mrna-cancer-vaccine-intersects-politics-medicine/?utm_campaign=rss)
  * Positive clinical readouts from personalized mRNA melanoma vaccine trials have provided proof-of-concept for expanding mRNA platforms into broader therapeutic oncology indications.

* **[Biotech]** **BioVie completes treatment phase of Phase 2 ADDRESS-LC trial in Long COVID** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2094395747143749969)
  * BioVie completed patient dosing in the Phase 2 ADDRESS-LC trial evaluating bezisterim for neurological symptoms secondary to Long COVID.
  * Topline clinical data from the trial are expected before the end of September.

* **[Biotech]** **Alpha Tau Medical completes enrollment in pilot trial of Alpha DaRT for pancreatic cancer** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2094395392372723730)
  * Patient enrollment is complete in the multicenter IMPACT pilot study evaluating Alpha DaRT targeted alpha-therapy in pancreatic cancer.
  * Initial trial readouts are projected for early 2027.

* **[Biotech]** **REVEAL trial validates ¹²⁴I-evuzamitide PET/CT imaging in cardiac amyloidosis** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42669054/)
  * Results from the nonrandomized REVEAL trial demonstrated the clinical diagnostic utility of ¹²⁴I-evuzamitide PET/CT imaging for identifying amyloid deposits in patients with suspected cardiac amyloidosis.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Big Pharma]** **AstraZeneca reports CARDIOTTRansform secondary analysis for eplontersen in ATTR cardiomyopathy** [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04670-6)
  * A secondary analysis of the Phase 3 CARDIOTTRansform trial showed that the transthyretin-targeting antisense oligonucleotide eplontersen (Wainua) produced clinical benefit in ATTR cardiomyopathy patients naive to TTR stabilizers at baseline, but demonstrated no incremental efficacy in patients on background stabilizer therapy.
  * The subgroup findings follow broader competitive positioning efforts between AstraZeneca and Alnylam regarding transthyretin-directed heart disease portfolios [[STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/30/alnylam-attr-astrazeneca-wainua-attruby-heart-disease/?utm_campaign=rss)].

* **[Biotech]** **Axsome Therapeutics initiates Phase 3 SUMMIT study of AXS-05 in smoking cessation** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2094391870948266074)
  * Axsome has initiated patient dosing in the pivotal Phase 3 SUMMIT trial evaluating AXS-05 (dextromethorphan/bupropion) as a treatment for smoking cessation.

* **[Big Pharma]** **AbbVie reports Phase 3 upadacitinib subgroup outcomes in East Asian Crohn's disease** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42669112/)
  * Post hoc analysis of Phase 3 induction and maintenance trials confirmed that upadacitinib (Rinvoq) maintains efficacy and safety consistent with global cohorts in East Asian patients with moderate-to-severe Crohn's disease.

* **[Big Pharma]** **DAPA ACT HF-TIMI 68 analysis evaluates in-hospital dapagliflozin initiation** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42669075/)
  * An analysis of the DAPA ACT HF-TIMI 68 trial demonstrated the decongestive efficacy of initiating AstraZeneca's SGLT2 inhibitor dapagliflozin in patients acutely hospitalized for heart failure.

* **Pulmonary vein isolation and low-voltage ablation trials report outcomes in Atrial Fibrillation** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42669307/)
  * The double-blind, sham-controlled PVI-SHAM-AF trial established baseline clinical efficacy for catheter ablation versus a sham procedure in symptomatic atrial fibrillation.
  * The randomized IDEAL-AF trial evaluated low-voltage area ablation strategies for optimizing outcomes in persistent atrial fibrillation [[PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42669133/)].

* **ACASA-TAVI trial compares post-procedural antithrombotic regimens** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42669043/)
  * The randomized ACASA-TAVI trial evaluated single oral anticoagulation monotherapy against antiplatelet monotherapy following transcatheter aortic valve implantation.

## Regulatory & Approvals

* **[Big Pharma]** **FDA approves Takeda and Protagonist's Mimrylo for polycythemia vera** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/30/fda-approves-mimrylo-takeda-protagonist-treatment-for-polycythemia-vera/?utm_campaign=rss)
  * The FDA approved Mimrylo (rusfertide), co-developed by Takeda and Protagonist Therapeutics, as a first-in-class treatment for the rare blood cancer polycythemia vera.

* **[Biotech]** **Karyopharm submits sNDA for Xpovio combination in myelofibrosis** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2094392602736926799)
  * Karyopharm Therapeutics submitted a supplemental NDA to the FDA for Xpovio (selinexor) in combination with ruxolitinib for patients with myelofibrosis.

* **[Biotech]** **Palvella Therapeutics completes rolling NDA submission for QTORIN rapamycin** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2094392422155350201)
  * Palvella Therapeutics completed its rolling NDA submission to the FDA for QTORIN rapamycin topical gel for the treatment of microcystic lymphatic malformations.

* **[Biotech]** **Ideaya aligns with FDA on Phase 3 design for DLL3-ADC IDE849 in lung cancer** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2094364907068137790)
  * Ideaya Biosciences completed a successful Type C meeting with the FDA, reaching agreement on Phase 3 registrational trial design for IDE849 (DLL3 TOP1 ADC) to support accelerated and full approval pathways in extensive-stage small cell lung cancer.

* **[Biotech]** **Beyond Air receives FDA Breakthrough Designation for LungFit GO** [X / Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2094394992017981467)
  * Beyond Air was granted FDA Breakthrough Device Designation for its LungFit GO delivery system for the treatment of nontuberculous mycobacterial pulmonary disease (NTM-PD).

## Public Health & Policy

* **Naturopath Wendy Weber appointed Director of NCCIH** [Science-Based Medicine](http://sciencebasedmedicine.org/wendy-weber-a-naturopath-now-leads-nccih-let-the-quackery-flow-even-more/)
  * Naturopathic practitioner Wendy Weber was appointed Director of the National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health (NCCIH), prompting discussion among scientific advocates regarding integrative medicine research priorities.

* **Perimenopausal symptoms drive $56.7 billion in annual US workplace productivity loss** [bioRxiv/medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.05.26357306)
  * A survey of 945 U.S. women showed that perimenopause increases work impairment from 12.7% (premenopausal) to 22.5%, representing an estimated $6,061 per-woman annual productivity cost primarily driven by presenteeism.

* **THESUS-HF II prospective registry tracks acute heart failure across 17 African nations** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42669305/)
  * Results from the prospective THESUS-HF II observational cohort study detailed the etiology, clinical management, and post-discharge outcomes of acute heart failure across 17 African countries to support regional public health planning.

- Biology & Health
    - [The Link Between Oats and Heart Disease: Harm or Help?](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c0Hm9tQ9zuc) -- Physionic
        - Analyses of whole grain and oat intake show potential protective associations against coronary heart disease, myocardial infarction, stroke, and overall cardiovascular mortality.
        - Physicochemical properties of oat β-glucan—specifically its viscosity—play a key role in lowering serum LDL cholesterol, delaying gastric emptying, and reducing postprandial glycemic and insulinemic responses.
        - The video evaluates how processing levels, intake amounts, and different forms of oats influence cardiovascular risk profiles and secondary prevention in patients with coronary artery disease.
    - [406 ‒ Migraine, cluster headache, and tension headache: symptoms, causes, prevention, and treatment](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uiNEP8A34SE) -- Peter Attia MD
        - Primary headache disorders are differentiated into migraine, tension, and cluster headaches, contrasting them with secondary headaches and highlighting widespread misdiagnosis across clinical practice.
        - Migraines affect approximately 12% of the population with a higher prevalence in women, progressing through premonitory, aura, headache, and postdrome phases driven by genetic, hormonal, neurovascular, and inflammatory signaling mechanisms.
        - Cluster headaches disproportionately affect men, produce severe localized pain, and are frequently misattributed to sinus or allergic etiologies.
        - Prevention and acute management strategies include lifestyle modifications, CGRP antagonists (monoclonal antibodies and gepants), calcium channel blockers, Botox, acute pharmacological treatments, and electrical stimulation devices.
    - [Why the Cash-Pay Behavioral Health Market Is Collapsing](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/6vmxcrZpmw8) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - Stephanie Davis outlines the market shifts causing the collapse of cash-pay business models in behavioral healthcare.
        - Rising consumer demand for affordable care is driving a transition away from out-of-pocket payment structures.
        - Expanding health insurance reimbursement coverage for mental health services is reshaping provider models and digital health market dynamics.
